title: England Captain Harry Kane Plays Golf with Donald Trump
summary: England captain Harry Kane has confirmed playing golf with US President Donald Trump, sparking a surreal experience for the football star. The outing occurred during Kane's recent visit to the United States. While details of their meeting are scarce, it is notable that Kane praised Trump's game, highlighting the unusual nature of their encounter.
